units.source_text: 天空乌云密布，永无散时。

en.t: The sky was thickly covered with dark clouds, with no sign that they would ever clear.
Day and night the heavy rain went on without ever stopping.

units.source_text: 京中消息沉沉，益觉深可悬念。

en.t: There was no word from the capital, which made him feel all the more deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 感伤之余，想道：“莫非我将永辞人世，就此毁身灭迹么？”

en.t: In his sorrow, he thought, "Can it be that I am to leave this world forever and vanish here without a trace?"

units.source_text: 但此时大雨倾盆，头也不能伸出户外，因此京中绝无来使。

en.t: But just then the rain was pouring down so hard that one could not even put one's head outside, and so no messenger came from the capital.

units.source_text: 只有二条院的紫姬不顾一切，派来一个使者，其人浑身湿透，形态怪异。

en.t: Only Lady Murasaki at the Nijo residence, disregarding everything, sent a messenger, who was soaked from head to foot and looked strangely altered.

units.source_text: 倘在路上遇见，定要疑心他是人是鬼。

en.t: Had one met him on the road, one would surely have wondered whether he was human or a ghost.

units.source_text: 虽然是这样丑陋的一个下仆，以前必然赶快把他逐去，但现在源氏公子觉得非常可亲。

en.t: Though he was such a wretched-looking servant that Genji would once have quickly sent him away, now the prince found him deeply endearing.

units.source_text: 他亲自接见下仆，自己也觉得委屈，可知近日心情已经大非昔比了。

en.t: He received the servant in person, feeling humbled by it himself, which showed how greatly his feelings had changed from former days.

units.source_text: 此人带来紫姬的信，写道：“连日大雨，片刻不停。

en.t: The man brought a letter from Lady Murasaki, which said, "For days the rain has fallen without stopping for even a moment.

units.source_text: 层云密布，天空锁闭，欲望须磨，方向莫辨。

en.t: Layer upon layer of clouds fill the sky and shut it away; when I try to look toward Suma, I cannot even tell the direction.
